_notes: CF CREW B owns day -19. CF B ONE: Time In CF JOB 07:00, Time In CF MEAL JOB 11:00, Time Out 11:30 = 3 time cards, 2 job cards; the meal card has Net Time 0. Fix web-pet #1535: a zero-net card on the PREFERENCE's Meal Job is refused ('Does not need Exporting') and counted Correct.

Precondition: su has mealJob null, so '0 - Lunch' is an ordinary job and the card the ticket is about never exists. The test designates CF MEAL JOB (9073) on Preferences > Job > Job Assignments > Meal Job on screen, restores '— None —' on screen at the end; a cleanup PUT {mealJob: 0} is the backstop. Another person's non-CF meal job is never overwritten.
The log is the client-side file the Analyze Results alert's Yes downloads; teardown deletes own cards by id (stands in for the TC's Reverse).
